name: Annie Whiting
career_history: Site Development Program Manager at Verrus, 6/2026 to present; Preconstruction Manager at Yondr, 11/2025 to 6/2026; Senior Project Manager at BE&K Building Group, 6/2025 to 11/2025; Senior Project Manager at MGAC, 4/2023 to 3/2025; Construction Manager at AWS, 9/2022 to 4/2023; Construction Manager at Amazon, 9/2019 to 4/2023
biography:
With extensive experience in industrial and data center construction, I am a seasoned professional skilled in mission critical construction projects and campuses including: preconstruction services for 80-100 MW projects, construction oversight of data centers, and mission critical role out of a distribution network, overseeing 12 industrial projects in the span of 3 years. I have a record of collaborating with Fortune 10 companies, adapting to diverse owner requirements and program specifics.

Currently I have been the lead for preconstruction on three 80-100 MW data center projects which will transition to construction where I lead a campus build.  Other recent achievements include managing $402.7 million in project costs and delivering 12 buildings for Amazon, along with overseeing critical AWS projects. 

Previously, I served as a Project Manager at Summit Contracting and JOMCO, focusing on multifamily and commercial construction. My early career included roles at Verizon Wireless, CF Evans & Company, and Wood Partners, where I gained diverse construction management experience.

I am currently pursuing a Masters in Construction Law and Dispute Resolution at King's College London, expected to complete in Fall 2025. My educational background also comprises a Post-Graduate Certificate from UNC Charlotte, an MBA from Belmont University, and a Bachelor's in Construction Management from Clemson University, alongside an exchange program at the University of South Australia.
